title: Bundles
description: Export your config and apply it on another machine
selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one agent to export

confirmApply.title: Apply this bundle?
confirmApply.desc: This overwrites the selected agents' real config files. A snapshot of each file is taken first (see History), so changes can be undone.

secrets.label: Include secrets (MCP API tokens)
secrets.warn: The bundle will contain real API tokens — share with care.
secrets.safe: Tokens in MCP server env are replaced with a placeholder, so the bundle is safe to share.

notices.invalidFile: Not a valid Abyss bundle file.
